lastText: File ClosedThe Ring, Closed After the FactMinor VictorySoviet High Command, 1941 — 1945End of hostilities: OCTOBER 1945 (PROJECTED) — filed with minor delayImmediate AftermathVictory in Europe arrives around October 1945 — later than the historical May 1945, the price of choices that spent time to save men. The army that reaches Berlin has paid for the ground twice over — a war fought closer to the historical pattern of holding rigid lines regardless of the arithmetic, at the cost this campaign keeps returning to. The industrial evacuation was subordinated to front supply in 1941 — easing that autumn's crisis at a cost in Urals production capacity that every later year of this campaign quietly pays for. The Vistula was crossed to relieve the Warsaw Uprising rather than held at — the option history's Stavka did not take, run here against the fresh SS armor that was actually waiting at the city's approaches. The autumn 1942 reserve was weighted entirely south — Mars never launched, the Rzhev grinder's cost declined, and the single-theater concentration tested against the pinning argument Mars's defenders always made. No branch of this campaign reaches a different destination — only the timing and the price were ever in Soviet hands.One Year LaterVictory arrived behind the historical May 1945, which means Soviet forces are still consolidating a front the historical record had a year's head start settling by this point.
